## Signs and circulation fixtures

The contemporary sign system covers exhibit entrances, room labels, arcade directions, amenities, access closures, collection captions and the visitor map. All signs have wall, plinth, counter, monitor or floor mounts. The northern arcade doorway plant has moved to the window end of the hall. See [signage and wayfinding](09-signage-and-wayfinding.md).

## Installing a first puzzle

Create a new record from the [puzzle design template](../templates/puzzle-design.md). Give it a stable ID, explicit scope, exact evidence, exact solution, input destination, feedback, consequence, and an ambiguity review. Update this register and the progression graph. Artwork should be generated in deterministic code when exact counts or geometry matter. Do not infer a canonical solution from an illustration generated for mood.

Archive candidates should be referenced by legacy prototype and ID, then deliberately revised. A reference does not constitute adoption.
